set.body:
Goal: compare eyes4s output to independent reference evidence under explicit semantics.

Acceptance criteria:
- For every supported corpus fixture, eyes4s canonical output is compared to EDF API and available ASC-reference manifests.
- Timestamps, order, eye identity, record kinds, messages, block boundaries, and counts compare exactly.
- Parsed ASC decimal values compare exactly at the token contract; EDF-to-ASC numeric comparisons use named tolerances derived from converter precision, never a hidden epsilon.
- Metamorphic checks cover line-ending changes, valid whitespace changes, chunk repartitioning, conversion subsets, translation of GAZE coordinates with matching frame changes, and independent block concatenation.
- Every mismatch reports fixture, source operands, field path, expected, actual, and tolerance.
- Unsupported configurations fail as unsupported rather than being counted as conformance successes.
- A machine-readable result summary is produced for the release validation artifact.
set.title: Run the EyeLink differential and metamorphic conformance court
